title: Realization of projection followed by finite exchange
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, a finite extension E of Q_l, n >= 1, a six-functor datum S [def-sf-operation-stages], a compactified Cartesian square Q, bounded constructible K on X and finite-Tor constructible L on Y [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. Let M be K tensor f-star L. Define d as inverse tensor realization followed by the tensor image of fixedPullRealization for f on L. Define mid as supportRealization for f-prime on g-prime-star M followed by the realized support image of fixedPullRealization for g-prime on M composed with derived g-prime pullback of d. Then the intrinsic image of g-star of the projection component followed by the prescribed exchange, postcomposed with mid, equals the prescribed square source comparison [def-sf-finite-base-change-realization-paths] followed by realization of the fixed g-star projection followed by the fixed compact-support exchange. No final tensor transport occurs.

proof.text: Naturality of pullRealization, followed by the inverse fixed-pull comparison, transports the pullback of the projection component to inverse coefficient coordinates. The proved fixed_component_realization and inverse_unit_naturality calculations identify that component with the fixed projection between its two tensor coordinates.

Expand the prescribed exchange as its coordinate conjugation. Its support comparison and inverse cancel against mid, and its inverse pull-coordinate comparison cancels. Naturality of the fixed exchange moves d to the source; naturality of fixedPullComparison moves the support input comparison past it. Paste this square with the preceding projection square. Functoriality and associativity identify the common source with SquareSource.

theorem sixFunctorProjectionFinite_left_prefix
    (S : SixFunctorDatum D C E n hn) (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D)
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn Q.X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Q.Y.obj.left) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn
    let A := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n)
    let RX := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.X
    let RY := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.Y
    let R' := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.Y'
    let TX := fixedTensor (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) Q.X
    let U := fixedDerivedPull (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) Q.g'
    let F := sfFixedCompactSupport (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n)
      (Q.compactification.ofIsPullback Q.square)
    let I := (intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible C.l E n hn Q.Y'.obj.left).ι
    let M := ((partialTensor S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.X).obj K).obj
      ((torPull S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f).obj L)
    let d := sixFunctorProjectionFiniteTensorRealization S Q.X K
        ((torPull S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f).obj L) ≪≫
      (TX.obj (RX.inverse.obj K.obj)).mapIso
        (fixedPullRealization S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f ⟨L.obj, L.property.1⟩)
    let mid := supportRealization S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f'
        (Q.compactification.ofIsPullback Q.square) ((S.finite.pull Q.g').obj M) ≪≫
      R'.functor.mapIso (F.mapIso
        (fixedPullRealization S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.g' M ≪≫ U.mapIso d))
    I.map ((S.finite.pull Q.g).map
        (component S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f Q.compactification K L)) ≫
      I.map (sixFunctorProjectionFiniteExchange S Q M) ≫ mid.hom =
    (sixFunctorProjectionFiniteSquareSource S Q K L).hom ≫ R'.functor.map
      ((FiniteProjectionExchange.pull A Q.g.hom.left).map
          (FiniteProjectionExchange.pf A Q.compactification
            (RX.inverse.obj K.obj) (RY.inverse.obj L.obj)) ≫
        FiniteProjectionExchange.ex A Q.square Q.compactification
          (FiniteProjectionExchange.tensor A Q.X.obj.left (RX.inverse.obj K.obj)
            ((FiniteProjectionExchange.pull A Q.f.hom.left).obj (RY.inverse.obj L.obj))))
